environment_variables.name: DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.purpose: Neon PostgreSQL pooled connection string for application runtime
environment_variables.validation_rule: Must begin with postgresql:// and specify sslmode=verify-full
environment_variables.failure_behavior: Fails closed (500 internal server error without leaking connection string)

environment_variables.name: DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED
environment_variables.purpose: Direct unpooled connection for migration DDL execution
environment_variables.validation_rule: Must begin with postgresql:// on direct port 5432

environment_variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
environment_variables.purpose: Session signing and cryptographic token generation

environment_variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
environment_variables.purpose: Base URL for authentication callbacks and CSRF validation

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
environment_variables.failure_behavior: Client navigation falls back to window.location.origin

environment_variables.name: FUNNEL_ANALYTICS_VIEWER_USER_IDS
environment_variables.purpose: Comma-separated user IDs authorized to access internal funnel analytics
environment_variables.failure_behavior: Renders HTTP 404 access denied for unauthorized users

environment_variables.name: DASHBOARD_ENABLED
environment_variables.purpose: Controls access to main business dashboard feature

environment_variables.name: ENTITLEMENTS_ENABLED
environment_variables.purpose: Enforces monthly report entitlement window restrictions

environment_variables.name: FUNNEL_ANALYTICS_ENABLED
environment_variables.purpose: Controls internal funnel analytics route accessibility
